attributes.name: SKU ID
attributes.description: The merchant's internal Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) used for inventory management.

attributes.name: Product Title
attributes.description: The title or name of the product.

attributes.name: Product Description
attributes.description: A detailed description of the product, including its features and specifications.

attributes.name: Vendor
attributes.description: The supplier or vendor of the product.

attributes.name: Brand Name
attributes.description: The brand or manufacturer associated with the product.

attributes.name: Tags
attributes.description: A comma-separated list of keywords or labels used to organize, search, and filter products.

attributes.name: Price
attributes.description: The selling price of the product.

attributes.name: Compared Price
attributes.description: The original or compare-at price used to show discounts.

attributes.name: Purchasing Cost
attributes.description: The cost incurred to purchase or manufacture the product.

attributes.name: UPC
attributes.description: The Universal Product Code (UPC), a 12-digit global product identifier primarily used in the United States and Canada.

attributes.name: EAN
attributes.description: The European Article Number (EAN), a 13-digit global product identifier used internationally.

attributes.name: GTIN
attributes.description: The Global Trade Item Number (GTIN), which includes GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), and GTIN-14.

attributes.name: ISBN
attributes.description: The International Standard Book Number (ISBN) assigned to books.

attributes.name: HSN Code
attributes.description: The Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) code used for tax classification.

attributes.name: Net Weight
attributes.description: The net weight of the product excluding packaging, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: Dead Weight
attributes.description: The actual physical weight of the product in kilograms.

attributes.name: Volumetric Weight
attributes.description: The volumetric or dimensional weight of the product in kilograms, used for shipping calculations.
